topics.title: Prayer
topics.icebreaker: When load shedding hits at the worst possible time, what's the first thing you usually do or say?
questions: What does Jesus teach us about the heart behind prayer, not just the words we use?
Why do you think Jesus tells us to pray "in secret"?
What role does prayer play in your daily rhythm right now?
What makes it hard to pray consistently in your context (work, taxi, family, load shedding)?
Who in your life needs you to pray for them this week?

topics.title: Holiness
topics.icebreaker: What's one "unwritten rule" in your family or community that everyone just knows to follow?
questions: What does it mean that God is holy, and why does that matter for how we live?
How is holiness different from just following rules?
Where do you feel the pull to "conform to the pattern of this world"?
What would it look like for your everyday life to be "set apart" this week?
How does the Holy Spirit help us grow in holiness rather than just trying harder?

topics.title: Identity in Christ
topics.icebreaker: Growing up, what did people expect you to become - and is that who you are today?
questions: According to these verses, what has changed about you since you became a follower of Jesus?
What labels (from family, culture, or past mistakes) do you still struggle to let go of?
What does it mean that you are "God's handiwork, created for good works"?
How would your week look different if you truly believed you were chosen and dearly loved?
Who around you needs to hear that their identity isn't defined by their past or circumstances?

topics.title: Holy Spirit
topics.icebreaker: Tell us about a time someone unexpected gave you exactly the help you needed.
questions: What roles does Jesus say the Holy Spirit plays in our lives?
Which "fruit of the Spirit" do you most need to grow right now?
How have you experienced the Holy Spirit's presence or power this year?
What's the connection between the Holy Spirit and being God's witnesses?
What would change if we relied on the Spirit's power more than our own effort?

topics.title: Forgiveness
topics.icebreaker: Share a small annoyance from this week that you had to let go of quickly (a taxi driver, a colleague, a family member).
questions: What does Jesus teach about the limits - or lack of limits - on forgiveness?
Why is forgiving others so closely tied to remembering what God has forgiven in us?
Is there someone you're finding it hard to forgive right now? (You don't have to name them.)
What's the difference between forgiving someone and trusting them again?
What's one step of forgiveness God might be asking of you this week?

topics.title: Mission
topics.icebreaker: If you had to explain what a Table Group is to a stranger at a taxi rank in one sentence, what would you say?
questions: What does Jesus actually send us to do?
Why do you think Jesus said, "As the Father sent me, I am sending you"?
Who are the people near you - your "Jerusalem" - who don't yet know Jesus?
What holds you back from talking about Jesus with others?
Who is one person you could intentionally build a friendship with this month, with mission in mind?

topics.title: Stewardship
topics.icebreaker: What's something you own that you look after really carefully - and why?
questions: What does this passage teach us about how God views the gifts, time, and money He's given us?
Why do you think the servant who buried his talent was punished, not just the one who achieved least?
What has God entrusted to you - skills, money, time, relationships - that you haven't fully used?
How do we balance being faithful with little and trusting God for more?
What's one practical way you could steward your resources better this week?

topics.title: Serving
topics.icebreaker: Who is someone who served you without expecting anything back, and how did it make you feel?
questions: Why did Jesus, being Lord, choose to wash His disciples' feet?
What's the difference between serving out of duty and serving out of love?
Where do you find it hardest to serve - at home, at work, or at church?
Who is easy for you to serve, and who is difficult?
What's one act of service you could do this week without being asked?

topics.title: Faith
topics.icebreaker: Have you ever had to trust something you couldn't fully see, like getting into a taxi with no idea of the exact route? What was that like?
questions: How does the Bible define faith?
What does the father's cry, "I believe; help my unbelief!" tell us about honest faith?
Why does James say faith without action is dead?
What's an area of life where your faith feels weak right now?
What's one step of faith God is inviting you to take this week?

topics.title: Grace
topics.icebreaker: Tell us about a time someone gave you a second chance you didn't deserve.
questions: What's the difference between grace and simply "being a nice person"?
Why is it important that grace can't be earned by works?
Where in your life do you still try to "earn" God's approval?
How does understanding grace change the way we treat people who mess up?
Who in your life needs to experience grace from you this week?

topics.title: Love
topics.icebreaker: What's a small way someone showed you love this week - a text, a plate of food, a lift somewhere?
questions: Which description of love in this passage challenges you most?
Why does Jesus say our love for each other is the mark that we're His disciples?
Is it possible to say we love God but struggle to love people? Why or why not?
Who is someone difficult to love that God might be calling you to love anyway?
What's one practical way to show love in your home or community this week?

topics.title: Community & Belonging (Ubuntu)
topics.icebreaker: What does the phrase "umuntu ngumuntu ngabantu / motho ke motho ka batho" mean to you in your own life?
questions: What did the early church's shared life together look like practically?
Why does God design us to need each other rather than go it alone?
Where do you feel most a sense of belonging right now - and where do you feel isolated?
How does this Table Group reflect (or not yet reflect) the community described in Acts 2?
Who could you invite deeper into community with you this week?

topics.title: Trust in God
topics.icebreaker: What's something in life right now that feels completely out of your control?
questions: What does it mean to trust God "with all your heart" rather than leaning on your own understanding?
When has fear tempted you to trust yourself more than God?
What promise from these verses do you need to hold onto this week?
What's a current situation where you're finding it hard to trust God's plan?
How can this group support you in trusting God through that?

topics.title: Hope in Hard Times
topics.icebreaker: Think of a tough season you've come through - what, or who, kept you going?
questions: How does Paul say suffering can actually produce hope?
What does it mean that God's mercies are "new every morning"?
Where do you need hope right now - personally, in your family, or in South Africa?
How is biblical hope different from just "staying positive"?
Who could you encourage this week with the hope you have in Christ?

topics.title: Generosity
topics.icebreaker: Who's the most generous person you know, and what have you learned from them?
questions: What does Paul mean by sowing "generously" versus "sparingly"?
Why does God love "a cheerful giver" rather than a reluctant one?
What holds people back from being generous - fear, habit, or not feeling like they have enough?
What has God given you that you could be more generous with - money, time, food, or a listening ear?
What's one generous act you could plan for this week?

topics.title: Family
topics.icebreaker: What's a family tradition - a Sunday lunch, a braai, a song - that shaped who you are?
questions: What does it mean for a household to "serve the Lord" together?
What pressures do families in South Africa face that make faithfulness hard?
How is God inviting you to lead or serve your family - however that looks for you - differently?
Where do you need healing or patience in a family relationship right now?
What's one way you could bless a family member this week?

topics.title: Work & Purpose
topics.icebreaker: What was your very first job, and what did it teach you?
questions: What does it mean to work "for the Lord" rather than for people?
How does knowing God gave Adam work before the Fall change how you see work?
Where do you struggle to see purpose in your daily work, studies, or the search for a job?
How can you bring integrity and excellence into your workplace, classroom, or home this week?
If you're unemployed or between jobs, how do these verses speak to you right now?

topics.title: Justice & Mercy
topics.icebreaker: Where in your community do you see something that clearly isn't right or fair?
questions: What three things does Micah say the Lord requires of us?
Why do you think justice and mercy are held together, not separated?
Where do you see injustice around you - at school, work, or in your neighbourhood?
What's one practical way ordinary people can "act justly" in daily life?
Who is someone vulnerable you could stand up for or help this week?

topics.title: Humility
topics.icebreaker: Who's someone you know who is genuinely humble - what makes them stand out?
questions: What example of humility does Jesus give us in Philippians 2?
Why does God say He opposes the proud but gives grace to the humble?
Where does pride tend to show up in your own life - comparison, needing to be right, image?
What would it look like to "value others above yourself" this week?
Is there someone you need to apologise to or defer to in humility?

topics.title: Peace
topics.icebreaker: What usually steals your peace - traffic, money worries, the news, family conflict?
questions: How is the peace Jesus gives different from the peace the world offers?
What does Paul link peace to in Philippians 4?
What is currently robbing you of peace, and why?
How does keeping our mind "steadfast" on God bring peace, practically?
Who in your life needs you to be a peacemaker this week?

topics.title: Obedience
topics.icebreaker: Growing up, was there a rule you only understood the reason for later in life?
questions: What does Jesus say is the connection between love and obedience?
Why does God value obedience even above religious sacrifice?
Where do you know what God wants but are hesitant to do it?
What's the difference between hearing the Word and doing it?
What's one thing God has clearly asked of you that you could obey this week?

topics.title: Worship
topics.icebreaker: What song - church or otherwise - always moves you when you hear it?
questions: What does it mean to worship God "in spirit and in truth"?
How is worship more than singing on a Sunday?
What does Romans 12:1 mean by offering your body as a "living sacrifice"?
Where in your everyday life could worship show up - at work, in chores, in relationships?
What's one thing you're genuinely thankful for that you could turn into worship this week?

topics.title: Overcoming Temptation
topics.icebreaker: What's a food or habit you find almost impossible to resist?
questions: What promise does Paul give about temptation in 1 Corinthians 10:13?
How does James describe the process from temptation to sin?
What specific temptation do you find yourself facing again and again?
What "way out" has God provided that you haven't been using?
Who could you ask to keep you accountable in this area?

topics.title: Reconciliation
topics.icebreaker: What's a story - yours or one you know - of two people or groups who found a way back to each other after conflict?
questions: What "ministry of reconciliation" has God given to those who follow Him?
Why does Jesus say to sort out conflict with others before bringing an offering to God?
In our South African story, why is reconciliation such an important part of following Jesus?
Is there a relationship - personal, family, or community - where you need to pursue reconciliation?
What's one step you could take this week toward peace with someone?

topics.title: Contentment
topics.icebreaker: What's something you once thought would finally make you happy - and did it?
questions: What did Paul learn "the secret of" being content?
How does contentment differ from giving up on dreams or hard work?
Where does comparison - social media, neighbours, family - steal your contentment?
What has God provided that you might be overlooking right now?
What's one thing you could choose to be grateful for this week instead of chasing more?

topics.title: Perseverance
topics.icebreaker: What's the hardest thing you've ever finished - a race, a course, a season of life?
questions: Why does James say we can "consider it pure joy" when we face trials?
What does perseverance produce, according to this passage?
Where are you tempted to give up right now - a relationship, a goal, your faith?
How does "fixing our eyes on Jesus" help us keep going?
Who could encourage you to keep going this week, and who could you encourage?

topics.title: Wisdom
topics.icebreaker: What's the best piece of advice an older family member ever gave you?
questions: What does James promise about asking God for wisdom?
Why is "the fear of the Lord" described as the beginning of wisdom?
What decision are you facing right now that needs godly wisdom?
Where do you usually turn for advice - and is that the wisest source?
Who could you ask for godly counsel this week?

topics.title: Sharing Our Faith (Evangelism)
topics.icebreaker: Who first told you about Jesus, and what do you remember about that?
questions: What does Peter say should be our posture when we talk about our faith - ready, but how?
Why does Paul say people need someone to "tell them" about Jesus?
What makes you nervous about sharing your faith with others?
Who is someone in your life who doesn't yet know Jesus?
What's one natural, low-pressure way you could talk about your faith this week?

globalPrompts.together: Have tea, coffee or water together — build genuine relationship.
globalPrompts.askHighsLows: Ask about the highs and lows of the week since you were last together.
readTheBible: What does this tell us about God?
What does it tell us about ourselves?
What is God saying to us?
globalPrompts.liveIt: What will we do differently this week because of what we've read/heard?
globalPrompts.emptyChair: Who are we praying for? Who can we invite? Who can we intentionally encourage?
